name: FAQ
description: Questions and answers as native <details> disclosures (no script), in lines or cards; optionally one open at a time, and optionally with FAQPage structured data for search engines and AI answers.

layout.description: single: the heading above one column. split: the heading and introduction stay in a left column beside the list; stacks on a phone.

columns.description: Columns of questions on wide screens.

icon.description: The marker in each question's row: a plus that turns into a cross, or a chevron that turns over.

style.description: lines: rows divided by rules. cards: each question in a rounded box. plain: the browser's own disclosure triangle without rules or boxes, questions at the body size (WordPress's details block).

questionStyle.description: How the questions read. heading: a small heading (lg, heading weight). bold: body size in bold, as accordion and toggle titles often are. The plain style sets its own and ignores this.

items.label: Questions

question.label: Question
question.description: The question, as the visitor would ask it.

answer.label: Answer
answer.description: The answer; links and lists allowed.

items.description: The questions in order (core/details summary + content, Elementor accordion/toggle tabs, Divi accordion/toggle items).

exclusive.description: One answer open at a time (Elementor accordion, Divi accordion). Off for toggles.

openFirst.description: The first answer starts open (Divi open_toggle, Elementor active item 1).

schema.description: Emit FAQPage JSON-LD built from these items. Use on at most one FAQ per page, and only when the page is really a FAQ.

measured.description: The source section's measured style (MeasuredStyle): frame width, padding, fill, image, columns per width, gap, text tone, radius, minimum height — all in pixels. Absent, the site's tokens; present, it wins over tone and columns. Values that are not a number, a colour or a known keyword are dropped.

color.description: Fill colour: hex, rgb(a) or hsl(a).

image.description: Background image address (http(s) or root-relative), drawn behind the content.

overlay.description: Colour or linear/radial gradient laid over the image or the fill.

size.description: cover, contain or auto; anything else draws as cover.

position.description: One or two of center/top/bottom/left/right or percentages.

columns.description: Item columns at 390 (base), 768 (md) and 1280 (lg) px; a missing width follows the narrower one.

tone.description: What the text is set for: dark = light text on a dark band. Without it, a fill's own lightness decides.

align.description: Where the heading and lead sit; read by a component whose own align is not set.

id.description: Section id; also the exclusive group's name.

numbered.description: Count the questions with a leading number, drawn by the page's style rather than written into the text.

a11y: Native <details>/<summary>: keyboard operable and announced as expandable by every screen reader, with no script to fail. The plus icon is decorative. The JSON-LD answer text is the answer with its markup removed.
